chase_layout.notes: Triple groups at +/-17 cells, lower one barrel and upper two barrels visual will be adjusted to model bounds; bowsprit raised over them. Final muzzle clearance checked from export before acceptance.

appearance.stern: three tier galleries, gothic arch, branching coral crown
appearance.bow: open beakhead, paired horn teeth, two fixed triple clusters
appearance.personal: a broken astrolabe carved into the stern arch, a tide mark through its empty centre

historical_type.value: 17th-century northern European armed ship / fluyt-galleon visual family

hull_dimensions.value: 52.0 m hull span; maximum nominal beam 13.4 m; design waterline 5.2 m above keel datum. Broader than Batavia ratios to support two gun decks and the game silhouette; no real stability certification.

hull_lines.value: Original smooth longitudinal width interpolation, rounded rising floor and tumblehome; not traced museum lines. Every station below is a new design coordinate.

deck_heights.value: 2.5 m between full gun decks for game crew and cannon clearance; deliberately exceeds Vasa's cramped historical deck headroom.

rig.value: Three masts and ten historic sails are source context; final new rig will use fore/main square sails and a mizzen lateen-like visual adapted to supported gaff meta. Mast heights and stations are original.

guns.value: 48 broadside guns and six fixed forward guns. 24l / 18chase are current supported game codes, not a claim about movie or Vasa calibres. Triple appearance has no new rotation mechanic.

ornament.value: D23 miniature personally inspected: tall projecting stern, concentric galleries, gothic ribs, branching coral crest; bow close-up shows paired triangular three-barrel clusters and pointed rail fins. Astrolabe motif is Sirius's invention.

waterline.value: 52 cells; pass explicitly as ship meta; tune ballast only after game hydrostatics measurement.
